answer: A session proves it is alive by sending a signed heartbeat every few minutes, each heartbeat carrying a strictly increasing sequence number. The server rejects heartbeats that arrive out of order or repeat a number, so a replayed session transcript cannot be reused to impersonate a live operator. One pearl proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of behaviour. From the sable to the whisper, the same rule holds: no continuity, no trust, no exception.
